payload.text: hv, 1 Nov, first-hand in devbin-vc's window at 11:16Z by devbin-vc's date -u, relayed by devbin-vc and received by vc's date -u of 11:20Z: "IT IS NO USE DOING ANY OF THIS OTHER WORK UNTIL DEVBIN IS SHIPPED. Why are we doing work on other builds (which takes AGES) when the whole point was to get devbin fixed and up and running efficiently SO THAT THE OTHER BUILDS HAPPEN MORE QUICKLY?" Effect, by devbin-vc: rhadamanth's desk grants devbin's ST0011 runs and nothing else until Devbin 0.1.19 is cut and swept into the fleet, and refuses every other ask. Utilz is parked: no run, no desk ask, no push, nothing for hv; vc, cc and dc hold, and a compact's pickup on vc's chain is the only write. It releases on devbin-vc's word that the sweep has reached Utilz; ST0031's order then is its design's, every run booked at the desk. Peers read this decision at pickup; cc and dc record no copy.
